# K Programming Language Guide — Version 0.9

## Introduction
K is an interpreted programming language.
## Running Programs
Run with: python interpreter/k_0_9_dev.py program.k
## Variables and Operators
Variables store values; operators perform calculations and comparisons.
## Conditions and Loops
Use conditions and loops to control program flow.
## Functions
Functions organize reusable logic.
## Classes and Objects
Classes define objects and their properties.
## Constructors
The init method initializes objects.
## Inheritance and Overriding
Child classes can inherit and override methods.
## Encapsulation and Static Methods
These features support organized object-oriented code.
## Exception Handling
K supports try, catch, finally and throw.
## Built-in Utilities
Utilities include length, type, abs, min, max, sum and range.
## Debugging
Development utilities include debug and assert_true.
## Development Notes
This guide describes the K 0.9 development interpreter.
